lines.intro: Meet Supertonic Server: natural speech in thirty-one languages, on your own computer. Free and open source.
lines.launch: Double-click the start file. It installs what it needs and opens the Studio in your browser.
lines.speak: Type anything, pick a voice, and press Generate.
lines.languages: The same voice speaks every language.
lines.voices: Ten built-in voices, each with a name and a style.
lines.clone: Or make a voice of your own from about half a minute of speech.
lines.build: Confirm you have permission, choose Best match, and build it on a graphics card.
lines.connect: Plug it into your apps: an OpenAI-compatible API, tools for AI agents, and realtime streaming.
lines.outro: Supertonic Server. Free, open source, and it runs offline.
